openFindings.title: --track can route scaffold writes above the repository root
openFindings.description: Resolve the track and final scaffold destination before the first mkdir, then fail unless the canonical destination remains beneath REPO_ROOT/specs.
openFindings.scopeProof: The phase 005 card explicitly invokes create.sh with --track and sets the authoring write boundary to the packet and scratch folders. This is the command implementation used by that in-scope card.

openFindings.title: Strict validation can pass with a required task anchor missing
The checklist sync guard does not require a valid example route
Indented fenced examples can diverge between the two checks
openFindings.description: The shell mirror only recognizes fences at column one while the orchestrator accepts leading whitespace, so a fenced token can produce different rule results.
openFindings.scopeProof: Phase 003 REQ-002 requires the shell rule and orchestrator to agree; both implementation paths are in the declared target scope.

openFindings.title: The shell-only title provenance check lacks orchestrator parity
openFindings.description: The shell rule flags title provenance tokens that are absent from the orchestrator marker set, so the paired checks can return different results.
openFindings.scopeProof: Phase 003 calls this shell script a mirror and REQ-002 requires the paired implementations to agree.

openFindings.title: The authoring card omits the tracked scaffold metadata write
openFindings.description: State the script-managed track-root metadata update as an explicit scaffold exception in the card, or adjust the scaffold flow so its writes match the card boundary.
openFindings.scopeProof: The phase 005 target creates the card, and the card itself defines the authoring write boundary for the tracked create.sh command.

openFindings.title: The S8 playbook overrides the card's current scaffold command
openFindings.description: Add --with-goal to the S8 scaffold command, or narrow the S8 coverage claim to the card steps the scenario actually exercises.
openFindings.scopeProof: The phase 005 card is a named input to phase 008 S8, whose plan and implementation summary claim a Level 1 packet was authored from that card.

openFindings.title: The deciding anchor-score rule is missing from the benchmark recipe
The fill-guidance regression test omits add-on templates
